gloss: to offer; to provide; to supply

definitions.gloss: to offer; to provide; to supply
definitions.explanation: To make something available or give something to others, especially services, information, or resources.

examples.japanese: {情報|じょうほう}を{提供|ていきょう}する。
この{店|みせ}は{地元|じもと}の{食材|しょくざい}を{使|つか}った{料理|りょうり}を{提供|ていきょう}している。
examples.english: This restaurant serves dishes made with local ingredients.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{被災者|ひさいしゃ}に{住居|じゅうきょ}や{食料|しょくりょう}を{提供|ていきょう}する{方針|ほうしん}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The government announced a policy to provide housing and food to disaster victims.

notes:
A formal verb meaning to provide or offer. It is widely used in business, media, and official contexts. The noun form {提供|ていきょう} appears frequently in broadcasting — the phrase 「この{番組|ばんぐみ}は～の{提供|ていきょう}でお{送|おく}りします」 (This program is brought to you by ~) is heard on nearly every TV show.

USAGE:
- Takes the particle を: ～を{提供|ていきょう}する
- Very common in written and formal spoken Japanese
- Often used with abstract objects (information, services, opportunities) as well as concrete ones (food, housing)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- サービスを{提供|ていきょう}する: to provide a service
- {情報|じょうほう}を{提供|ていきょう}する: to provide information
- {食事|しょくじ}を{提供|ていきょう}する: to serve a meal
- {機会|きかい}を{提供|ていきょう}する: to offer an opportunity
- {資金|しきん}を{提供|ていきょう}する: to provide funding
- {番組|ばんぐみ}{提供|ていきょう}: program sponsorship
- {提供|ていきょう}{元|もと}: provider, source

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {供給|きょうきゅう}する: to supply — emphasizes steady supply of goods or resources (economic term)
- {与|あた}える: to give — more general; {提供|ていきょう}する implies organized, purposeful giving
- {差|さ}し{上|あ}げる: to give (humble) — polite interpersonal giving; {提供|ていきょう}する is institutional or professional
